name: After § 150
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 150a. Expresses dismay concerning the policy of the US administration of appeasing Russia and targeting its allies; warns that this policy undermines the trust of traditional US allies around the world and can have devastating consequences for the transatlantic bond, peace and stability in Europe and beyond; urges the Commission and Member States to develop an independent foreign and security policy on the basis of international law; reiterates the need for strategic independence from the US;
